services.name: gear rental
services.desc: WINTER BLUES? Not if you are flying in Mexico 🪂 ! Sign up for our Winter Tours! Dismiss The P1 Beginner Student course is planned over a 4-day long weekend. We visit multiple paragliding sites to provide experience sizing up new sites and best chances of capturing best weather conditions. We often do an overnight camp, so we can maximize flight time. By the end of your P1 you should have some good confidence with your launch and landing skills. We usually finalize this course with a Pemberton high flight. We highly recommend purchasing the equipment you will be training with it . If you do not have gear, we can provide full equipment rental, including: wing, harness, radio, reserve .

services.name: P2- Novice Student Flex Course
services.desc: WINTER BLUES? Not if you are flying in Mexico 🪂 ! Sign up for our Winter Tours! Dismiss Once you have completed the P1 you can then come complete you P2 at your own pace. Expect to dedicate at least a minimum of 10 flying days to complete to your P2 course and a total of 26 flight. If you have completed this course somewhere else we will need a personal assessment and/or referral from your instructor.
